name: Memcode Memory
description: Give Row-Bot opt-in long-term memory backed by the Memcode personal v2 API.
long_description: Search and inspect memories for the authenticated Memcode user. Retrieval is approval-gated because Memcode may learn Recall Bond relationships, and ingestion is approval-gated because it may change durable memories. Ingestion returns a durable receipt that can be polled. The plugin never accepts a caller-supplied user id; identity comes from the configured Memcode credential.

base_url.label: Memcode API URL
base_url.description: Base URL for the Memcode Memory API.

default_count.label: Default result count
default_count.description: Default number of search, retrieval, or list results (1-25).

api_key.label: Memcode API key
api_key.description: Integration-issued personal Memcode credential. Create it with Row-Bot selected in the Memcode dashboard; it determines which user's memories are accessible.
